pairs_with_note: This manifest holds the Metrale Engine leg only. series.evidence_note: Published-ladder data, not a gate record. The concurrency-sweep-moe gate covers C=1..16, and its signed records under .benchmarks/ remain the certified evidence for those rungs. C=32/64/128 exist only here.

protocol: One harness process per timed rep (--reps 1 --warmup 0), so every rep draws a fresh prompt nonce and none hits the prefix cache. Three blocks, each on a FRESH serve of the same command: block 1 is the serve the certified concurrency-sweep-moe gate command leases (--serve-reuse), blocks 2 and 3 re-run that serve's argv and environment verbatim. On each serve, one discarded warm-up rep runs at every rung first (that is the workload's warmup = 1), then one timed rep per rung, and every timed rep starts only after the GPU die has cooled to 55 C or below with the serve loaded and idle (nvidia-smi temperature.gpu polled every 5 s). Rung order per block: 1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128 / 128,64,32,16,8,4,2,1 / 32,64,128,1,2,4,8,16, so no rung always runs first or last on a serve. The vLLM legs in published.json ran each rung's 3 timed reps back to back after 1 warm-up inside one harness process, with no die gate, so their reps started at whatever die temperature the previous rep left; the die-gated start here is disclosed because a cooler die draws less power, and the peak die temperatures of the two legs are comparable (Metrale 62-80 C, vLLM 58-83 C across the ladder).
